scope: Three fixed, disclosed local-browser application contracts; repeated generations are not independent product-task samples.
trial_order: Repeat first, then profile in declared order
live_denominator: Every dispatched trial, including generation, verification, infrastructure, and accounting failures. Undispatched trials are separately counted against the planned sample.

accounting.uncertain_cost_action: Stop all further dispatch, retain reservation, require independent ledger and provider reconciliation.

claims_not_supported: Statistical reliability across arbitrary software projects
Superiority over another model, agent configuration, or human team

future_comparison.design: Independently curated task-family holdouts, paired configurations on the same tasks, equal declared budgets, randomized order, frozen graders, and all failures retained.
